results.consensus_summary: The legal document has been analyzed by a team of specialized AI agents including Risk & Liability Counsel, Opposing Counsel, Transaction Counsel, Neutral Legal Reviewer, and Regulatory & Compliance Counsel. An overall risk score of 10.0/10 has been assessed, indicating a Critical risk profile.

findings.summary: The clause contains broad indemnity obligations that could force the company to pay for third-party disputes and losses without a reciprocal cap. Recommend making this mutual.
Opposing counsel can leverage this broad indemnity to demand defense costs and settlement contributions even before liability is adjudicated in court.
The limitation of liability clause places an aggregate cap on damages. Review exclusions to ensure critical breaches remain compensable.
The carve-outs allow an aggressive opposing party to re-characterize breach claims to bypass the liability cap entirely.
The intellectual property language assigns ownership of created materials. Recommend clarifying background IP protections.
